integrity: A symbolic generator/derivative replay, rational backward-equation checks, and bounded deterministic numeric stress tests accompany a self-contained analytical proof. The scientific claim is an exact conditional theorem, not a numerical conjecture.
scientific_limitations: Continuous-time symmetric two-reserve occupancy chain with an all-killing common-catastrophe hazard and exponential colonization/catastrophe kernels; catastrophe hazard decays faster with separation than colonization. Models with partially destructive catastrophes, state-dependent catastrophic rates, reversed decay scales and finite-deadline objectives are not covered. The motivating source uses a different discrete-time process; no field-calibrated decision or independent validation is claimed.
title: Mean-persistence reserve spacing is never shorter than tail-persistence spacing
